data.description:
## Incident Overview

tests/workflows/test-review-workflow-severity-schema.sh greps REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and sprint SKILL.md for absence of literal strings 'MIN_SCORE' and 'all scores >= 4'. Negative-presence asserts via grep are brittle when the prose is restructured.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [13] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — intentional locking-out of legacy schema after epic 4b8f-924d.

## Suggested Fix

Add comment explaining lock-out intent, or pair grep with positive structural assertion that severity schema is documented.
